sources.title: run-gemini-cli readme
sources.locator: Overview; Features; Quick Start; Workflows; Configuration
sources.finding: The Action integrates Gemini CLI with GitHub issue/PR comment work, automatic reviews and scheduled/event workflows. Setup copies product workflows or uses the underlying CLIs setup command.

sources.title: run-gemini-cli action.yml
sources.locator: inputs gemini_cli_version and auth; Install Gemini CLI; Run Gemini CLI lines260-342; outputs
sources.finding: The composite action installs the selected Gemini CLI version, writes user settings, configures auth and invokes gemini --yolo --prompt ... --output-format json, retaining summary/error output.

sources.title: run-gemini-cli docs/authentication.md
sources.locator: Choosing Google Authentication; method sections; GitHub Authentication
sources.finding: Documents Gemini API keys, Vertex keys, Google Cloud WIF and Code Assist/Vertex routes; GitHub identity separately uses repository token or a custom GitHub App.

sources.title: run-gemini-cli examples/workflows/gemini-dispatch/gemini-dispatch.yml
sources.locator: on; dispatch if gate; selected workflow jobs
sources.finding: The source workflow handles issue/PR/review/comment events, checks trusted commenter association and dispatches to specialized workflows.

sources.title: run-gemini-cli examples/workflows/issue-triage/gemini-scheduled-triage.yml
sources.locator: on.schedule cron; concurrency group/cancel-in-progress; triage runs-on and timeout
sources.finding: The supplied hourly triage workflow runs on an Ubuntu Actions runner and cancels overlapping runs of the same workflow group.

sources.title: run-gemini-cli examples/workflows/gemini-assistant/README.md
sources.locator: Core features; Interaction Flow; exact plan-comment approval
sources.finding: Code changes use an exact bot-authored plan approval comment and verified plan artifact, after which the assistant may branch, commit and open a PR.

sources.title: run-gemini-cli examples/workflows/pr-review/README.md
sources.finding: The PR workflow uses Gemini CLI code-review extension and returns a structured review summary and inline GitHub comments.

sources.title: run-gemini-cli docs/observability.md
sources.finding: The optional OpenTelemetry route sends traces/metrics/logs to the users Google Cloud project through a configured collector, is documented disabled by default and has settings.enabled=false control. This is not proof about all Gemini CLI vendor telemetry.

sources.title: run-gemini-cli LICENSE
sources.finding: The composite Action and repository files carry Apache-2.0. That is not a blanket licensing statement for the separately fetched Gemini CLI or GitHub service.
